components.name: ThinkingShimmer
components.doc: "Thinking…" with a sheen that sweeps across the letters. The quietest indicator: use it inline, where a reply is about to start.

components.name: ThinkingDots
components.doc: Three dots that bounce in a wave, the classic "someone is typing" signal.

components.name: ThinkingPhrases
components.doc: A status phrase that changes every few seconds beside a small orbiting mark, for waits long enough that one word would feel stuck.

components.name: ThinkingSteps
components.doc: "Step 2 of 5" with one pip per step: finished pips fill, the current one breathes, and the number rolls when the step changes.

components.name: LoadingStates
components.doc: Indicators for the moments an AI is working and has nothing to show yet. One component with four variants; each variant is also exported on its own (`ThinkingShimmer`, `ThinkingDots`, `ThinkingPhrases`, `ThinkingSteps`).
